body.statement: When \(m=2\), \(\mathcal R(n,2,\tau)\asymp_{\beta,D}\ell n^{-\varkappa}\) uniformly for \(n\ge2\) and \(0<\tau\le1/(8n)\). Consequently, along every two-cell sequence, \(\mathcal R(n,2,\tau_n)\to0\) if and only if \(\log(1/\tau_n)=o(n^{\varkappa})\).
body.justification: The exactly matched two-cell case is a falsifiable boundary condition for every proposed many-cell frontier.
body.gap: GuggenbergerMehtaPavlov2026 finds finite-sample fixed-quantile minimax degeneracy for bounded outcomes; Hall extrapolation produces a nondegenerate moving-tail rate even with only two cells.
body.consumer: It tells an experiment with one capacity-constrained pair exactly how fast the deployment quantile may move beyond the sample while policy learning remains possible.
